title: MetrologyUncertaintyAndGuardedDecisionRuleSchema
description: Standardized metrology schema defining measurement uncertainty, calibration traceability, and project-wide Guarded Acceptance decision rules across Gates C1-C9.

project_decision_policy.standard_reference: ISO 14253-1:2017 & ILAC-G8:09/2019 (Binary Acceptance with Guard Band)
project_decision_policy.rationale: Declaring compliance purely when measured_value <= limit ignores instrument measurement error, creating unacceptable consumer risk (false pass). Guarded Acceptance establishes a guard band g equal to expanded uncertainty U (coverage factor k = 2, 95% confidence).

two_sided_interval_rule.degraded_zone: measured_value within [lower_limit, lower_limit + U) OR (upper_limit - U, upper_limit]

C1_CLOCK.measurement_method: Multi-modal optical strobe and physical impactor captured simultaneously by optical cameras and vehicle accelerometer, with PTP 1PPS probe monitoring on DSO.
C1_CLOCK.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope + Vector VN1640A Interface + Co-Calibration Rig
C1_CLOCK.decision_rule: measured_value <= (33.33 ms - 0.50 ms) = 32.83 ms for PASS

C2_CAMERA.measurement_quantity: Truss Clamp Fastener Bolt Torque & Frame Drop Counter
C2_CAMERA.measurement_method: Calibrated torque wrench physical audit of mounting bolts; Wireshark automated frame drop packet monitor on GigE/RTSP stream.
C2_CAMERA.instrument: Norbar Calibrated Torque Wrench (ISO 6789) + Wireshark Packet Monitor

C3_CAN.measurement_quantity: CAN Frame Transit Gap Maximum Latency
C3_CAN.measurement_method: High-impedance CAN tap capturing 50 Hz frame timestamps during low-speed shakedown run.
C3_CAN.instrument: Vector VN1640A CAN Interface + CANoe Log

C4_SECONDARY_OBSERVABILITY.measurement_quantity: Mannequin Optical Resolution at 20m Depth Plane
C4_SECONDARY_OBSERVABILITY.measurement_method: Laser distance meter placement of SPMT-01 mannequin at 9 grid points at 20m depth; automated OpenCV edge-gradient pixel density measurement.
C4_SECONDARY_OBSERVABILITY.instrument: Leica DISTO D2 Laser Measure + OpenCV Resolution Validator + SPMT-01 Target
C4_SECONDARY_OBSERVABILITY.decision_rule: measured_resolution >= (65.0 px/m + 2.5 px/m) = 67.5 px/m at 20m depth

C5_CALIBRATION.measurement_quantity: ChArUco Bundle Adjustment Reprojection Error RMS
C5_CALIBRATION.measurement_method: 50+ diverse pose acquisitions of 12x9 ChArUco diamond board per deployed camera; Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear reprojection optimization.
C5_CALIBRATION.instrument: Calib.io Certified Precision Aluminum ChArUco Diamond Target (12x9)
C5_CALIBRATION.instrument_calibration: Calib.io Optical Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) Certificate
C5_CALIBRATION.decision_rule: rms_reprojection_error <= (1.50 px - 0.08 px) = 1.42 px across all deployed cameras

C6_GEOMETRY.measurement_quantity: Facility Floor Ground Plane Fitting RMS Residual
C6_GEOMETRY.measurement_method: Reflectorless geodetic optical total station surveying 30+ floor points across corridor to fit Ax+By+Cz+D=0.
C6_GEOMETRY.instrument: Leica TS16 Total Station (1" angular accuracy, 1mm + 1.5ppm distance)

C7_ILLUMINANCE.measurement_quantity: Spatial Photopic Illuminance (E_v) & Optical Flicker Index (FI)
C7_ILLUMINANCE.measurement_method: Class B photometer 5-point grid survey (Path 1) + 1.0 MSa/s amplified photodiode DSO capture under luminaire optical axis (Path 2).
C7_ILLUMINANCE.instrument: Testo 540 Lux Meter + Thorlabs PDA36A2 Photodetector + Keysight DSOX1204G
C7_ILLUMINANCE.instrument_calibration: ISO/IEC 17025 Accredited Calibration Certificates for Photometer and DSO
C7_ILLUMINANCE.decision_rule: Every point 310.5 lux <= E_v <= 389.5 lux AND FI <= 0.047 AND f_mod >= 1000 Hz

C8_E_STOP.measurement_method: 4-channel isolated DSO measuring E-Stop NC dry contact opening to motor Phase U line current extinction (I_motor < 0.5 A RMS).
C8_E_STOP.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope + Tektronix TCP303 / A622 Current Clamp
C8_E_STOP.decision_rule: measured_latency <= (50.0 ms - 1.2 ms) = 48.8 ms WITH verified TRACTION_CURRENT_ENDPOINT_PERSISTENCE

C9_PRIVACY.measurement_quantity: Physical Microphone Disconnection Confirmation & Signed Legal Bilateral Agreement
C9_PRIVACY.acceptance_limit: Microphones disconnected == TRUE; Agreement signed == TRUE
C9_PRIVACY.measurement_method: Physical hardware desoldering audit under microscope + cryptographic signature verification on legal repository ledger.
C9_PRIVACY.instrument: Hardware Visual Microscope Inspection + SHA-256 Ledger Validator
C9_PRIVACY.decision_rule: Strict deterministic boolean check: mics_desoldered == True AND agreement_signed == True
